encoder: same fixed MiniLM, max_length 256, last layer
alignment: character-overlap weighted last-layer feature; L2; pooled fallback for unmatched spans
token_targets: full-vocabulary JS at all valid Qwen positions; averaging exactly recovers text target
token_ridge: document weight one; train GroupKFold3 tuned by document-mean MAE; alpha [.1,1,10,100]
token_gp: Matern3/2; same pooled-GP kernel family/bounds/target normalization; max768 observations, equal per-doc cap
holdout: same frozen document splits and measured text indices as pooled benchmark
uncertainty: no approximate aggregate sigma or theta; compare means only
limitation: bidirectional encoder contextualizes whole encoder window; fallback/coverage explicitly reported
